annotations.text:
A · Icon counts inline

Why: every number visible in one glance, rows stay one line tall.
Tradeoff: three icon+number pairs per row is the densest of the four; the icons must be learned once.

B · Caption breakdown

Why: plain words, nothing to decode, and the row still reads as a normal workspace switcher. Least "admin dashboard" feeling.
Tradeoff: taller rows and numbers are not column-aligned, so comparing across workspaces takes a little more reading.

C · Compare columns

Why: built for the actual question ("which workspace has the most?"): sorted by total, aligned columns, the top value per column is brighter.
Tradeoff: the header and sort control make it feel like a small table rather than a menu; widest panel.

D · Total + proportion bar

Why: one number per row plus a thin bar showing the mix; exact split only on hover (shown on Supply Chain). Most minimal at rest.
Tradeoff: mix is not readable without hovering, and the bar needs the legend at the bottom.
Counts shown are sample values for the mockup, not real workspace data. Active workspace (Finance) is highlighted with a check; the trigger shows its open state.
